description: Get raw Reddit comments from the r/wallstreetbets daily discussion thread, top-level comments newest first. Returns one comment per line in a compact threaded format, with 2-space indentation for each reply level; a comment's own line breaks show as ' / '. Each line starts with [S ↩N]: S is the comment's Reddit score (upvotes), refreshed about every 30 minutes for each thread's ~500 best-scored comments (the header gives the time; the newest comments have had little time to collect votes), and ↩N means N replies so far (all levels, omitted when none). Threads whose scores were never refreshed (before 2026-10-25) have no vote counts: their lines show only [↩N]. Bot commands, comments scored 0 or below, and short comments nobody replied to or upvoted are filtered out. Useful for directly analyzing retail investor sentiment, popular tickers, and trading ideas.

date.description: Specific date to get comments for (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for latest available discussion.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (1-1500). Default: 500

name: get_wsb_discussion
